jobs.command: python3 -c 'import json,sys; from pathlib import Path; from utils.config_resolver import method_name,method_storage_key,training_experiment_name; from utils.epsilon_profiles import epsilon_profile_name; n=method_name(step={step},encoder="{encoder}",method=2); k=method_storage_key(n); p=Path("save_model")/k/epsilon_profile_name(training_experiment_name(n,"highway",120)+"_traffic_safe_optionA","initial-0.5"); m=json.loads((p/"metadata_sim_0_149999.json").read_text()); files=("eval_net_sim_0_149999.keras","target_net_sim_0_149999.keras","cooperation_eval_sim_0_149999.weights.h5","cooperation_target_sim_0_149999.weights.h5"); valid=m.get("cooperation_method")==2 and m.get("slot")==149999 and all((p/f).is_file() for f in files); sys.exit(0 if valid else "Incomplete method 2 checkpoint: "+str(p))' && python3 evaluate_methods.py --agents Propose --method 2 --scenario highway --step {step} --encoder {encoder} --epsilon-profile initial-0.5 --mode safe --option A --xla off --num-vehicles {num_vehicles} --model highway:120 --load-slot 149999
